sources.quote: the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The approved supplier list covers BR-220 at PLT-BEI for CUST-AUR, but only for SUP-B. It has no entry for Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). The 2026-11-06 re-audit restored company standing only and changed no part approval. The claim that quality approved Chisone last week therefore does not give a BR-220 release.

sources.quote: Chisone is qualified for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5 only. BR-220 is drawn in 6082-T6, yield at least 250.
they can make BR-220 blanks from the same alloy they use for BR-310

findings.why: The drawing requires 6082-T6, and Chisone is qualified only for 6061-T6 and 6082-T5. Nothing in the documents shows that Chisone later gained 6082-T6 capability. The 2026-11-06 audit did not change part or material qualifications. The phone claim about the BR-310 alloy is unsupported, and it gives no temper or alloy.

findings.key: 8D on the 6082 cracks (Meccanica Chisone, no issue id in documents)

sources.quote: The 8D on the 6082 cracks is not closed yet, corrective action still being verified.
the cracking 8D on their 6082 material is still open

findings.why: Chisone has an open 8D on its 6082 material, and BR-220 is a 6082 part. As of 2026-11-06 it is still open. The 2026-10-02 board also required a closed 8D before any temporary source for BR-220.
